resources.string: Assists with user-started USSD transactions. Mobile Money PIN entry always remains manual.

AgentPro uses this service only when you start USSD automation. It reads the active USSD dialog so it can recognize network menus and enter non-PIN transaction details you already provided. PIN entry remains manual.

During a USSD automation you start, AgentPro reads text and interactive controls in the active USSD dialog to recognize menus and enter non-PIN details you already provided. Raw USSD screen text is processed only in memory during the active session and cleared when the session ends. AgentPro never stores or auto-enters your Mobile Money PIN; PIN entry is always manual.
